faqs.question: Why do I need two different sunscreens for face and body?
faqs.answer: Face skin is thinner, acne-prone, and spends more time under makeup — it needs a lightweight, non-comedogenic formula. Body skin is thicker and more exposed -it needs a hydrating, tan-correcting formula with a stronger moisture base. Using one for both leaves gaps in protection or causes breakouts.

faqs.question: Is SPF 50+ PA++++ enough for daily use?
faqs.answer: Yes. SPF 50+ blocks around 98% of UVB rays, and PA++++ is the highest UVA protection rating available - ideal for Indian sun exposure. Reapply every 2–3 hours if you're outdoors.

faqs.question: How long before I see the tan reduce?
faqs.answer: Tan correction is gradual. With daily use and consistent reapplication, most users notice more even skin tone within a few weeks. Results vary with skin type and sun exposure.

faqs.question: Will it leave a white cast?
faqs.answer: No. Both formulas are designed for Indian skin tones. The face sunscreen has an aqua-gel texture that disappears in 3 seconds; the body lotion absorbs clean with no ghostly film.

faqs.question: Is the face sunscreen safe for acne-prone skin?
faqs.answer: Yes- it contains ACZERO, a Korean anti-acne technology that is non-comedogenic and anti-inflammatory, tested safe even on active-acne skin.

faqs.question: Is it water and sweat resistant?
faqs.answer: The face sunscreen is clinically proven water and sweat resistant up to 80 minutes. The body lotion is non-transferring once absorbed. Reapply after swimming or heavy sweating.

faqs.question: Can I wear the face sunscreen under makeup?
faqs.answer: Yes. Apply after moisturiser, wait 60 seconds, then proceed with your makeup. It won't pill or ball up.

faqs.question: Is this duo suitable for men?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both formulas are gender-neutral and built around skin type and skin zone, not gender.
